enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Place head on pillow. Pull blanket over body. Place arms at sides. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Remain still.

Turn off alarm on phone. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse bowl. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for work, checking phone and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Change clothes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Open email. Reply to message. Lock phone. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place wallet in bag. Place keys in bag. Place phone in bag. Zip bag. Put on shoes. Stand up. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news. Listen to music. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patients. Update records. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Discuss cases. Write reports. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Listen to music. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Cut vegetables. Cut chicken. Put vegetables in pan. Stir. Add chicken. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch news. Adjust volume. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Drink water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Comment. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Pick up phone. Check time. Put down phone. Continue reading. Close book. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Eat snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read page.

Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open reading app. Read article. Scroll. Read another article. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Snore.
